subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked with the letters A to F. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f75fe27969eb19066ba4443394fc80685e0ab076ca50e7c90865c44a8c01c4.png]
solution:
As A is the common face, keeping it constant and then rotating in clockwise direction, we get the faces opposite to each other:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34bf99752e16609d17d9b430619d45a4d52601bddacf7f13b85076dcf80ef268.png] 

 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 
D

 
 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 
C

 
 
 
B

 
 
 

The other face is E which we get from the options.

Clearly, D, F, C and B are the faces adjacent to A and E is the face opposite to A.

Hence, '**E**' is the correct answer.
